items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: The trombone section was Jimmy Cleveland, Buster Cooper and Al

ctx.x: But back to what the musicians in the band...and he had quite a few good, top people in the band during the period I was there. Just to name some of the personnel: in the trumpet section it was Art Farmer, there was Quincy Jones, there was Al Williams, there was The Whistler. There were changes come along a little later, like Clifford Brown, Benny Bailey. And also Emory -- gosh, I can't think of Emory's -- big, fat trumpet player. I can't think of his name, but we used to call him the Fat Boy because he was huge,…

The trombone section was Jimmy Cleveland, Buster Cooper and Al -- oh, I'm sorry, I can't think of that trombone player's name (Hayes). And the rhythm section -- the reed section was Bobby Plater, he was beautiful, Bobby Plater; Morris Lane, Clifford Solomon, Oscar Estelle, the baritone, and...who else am I missing? It's been a lot of years and I keep...I've got up to the date in my mind.

Anyhow, the rhythm section was Elmer Gill, piano player, and I later worked with him for a spell, and after Elmer, me playing bass and William Mackell playing guitar. And after Elmer, Hamp went without piano. The band...
